dialogue: Ok so, have you ever got a lot of speed,
But realized you gotta change directions?
Ok so in that case you gotta do a [color=#f8c868]reverse boost[/color]!
All you gotta do, is hold the [color=#f8c868]opposite direction[/color] before you [color=#f8c868]jump[/color]!
It's a bit tricky, and you'll lose some speed-
But it is still a way faster way to turn around!
So try it out! Its probably a little tricky, but-
If you get in a good flow, you'll realize you can pretty much,
[color=#f8c868]Slide boost[/color] everywhere you want! As long as you don't hit anything!
If you want some more movement tips, check back in with me!
I got loads more where that came from!
